sources.use: PCB and 184 component solids tessellated into the viewer. Geometry-only mesh, recoloured for display. The fitted GPIO socket is added separately because it is absent from the STEP.
25.4 × 17.78 mm PCB, 1.57 mm PCB thickness; simplified component envelopes.
Two Ø3 mm mounting holes, 20.32 mm apart; their row is 6.35 mm from PCB centre.
DEV-14459 outline envelope 52.324 × 22.987 mm. Shared GPIO and four Qwiic port locations. Rounded corners and components simplified.
Frienda 2×20 extra-tall stacking header: 51 × 5 × 23 mm overall, 12 mm pins, 2.54 mm pitch, approximately 0.6 mm pin thickness. Dimensions from listing diagram and specifications.
Page 4 physical specification: board 25 × 23.862 × 1.12 mm, lens and connector dimensions, Ø2.2 mounting holes. Installed CSI connector exits toward the plate centre.
65 × 30 mm board and 58 × 23 mm mounting pitch. USB centres 41.4 and 54 mm from the SD end; HDMI centre 12.4 mm from that end. Components remain reference geometry.

notes: Native source CAD remains linked. Witty Pi geometry is published as a tessellated assembly reference; colours and GPIO socket are viewer additions. Other purchased components and free cable routing are simplified. Installed standoff bodies: Pi 15 mm, two Witty supports 20 mm, OLED 10 mm, RTC 10 mm, four retainers 5 mm. Pi and Witty supports have 6 mm male threads.
